name: DeepSeek-R1
summary: DeepSeek-R1 is a 671B-parameter reasoning Mixture-of-Experts model with 37B activated parameters and a 128K context window. DeepSeek publishes the code repository and weights under the MIT License.

rights.question: Commercial use
rights.notes: DeepSeek explicitly states that the R1 series supports commercial use.

rights.question: Derivative works
rights.notes: DeepSeek explicitly permits derivative works, including distillation.

rights.question: Redistribution
rights.notes: Standard MIT copyright and permission notice requirements apply.

rights.question: Distilled variants
rights.notes: Some R1-Distill checkpoints inherit underlying Qwen or Llama licensing considerations.

deployment.notes: DeepSeek provides an OpenAI-compatible API platform.
Official weights are published on Hugging Face.
DeepSeek directs full R1 deployments to the DeepSeek-V3 runtime guidance.
Current SGLang documentation validates direct DeepSeek-R1 deployment.
